Conjur Secrets Manager is CyberArk's machine-identity and secrets management platform, available as Conjur Open Source, Conjur Enterprise (Self-Hosted), and Conjur Cloud (SaaS). The REST API enables authenticating hosts and users, loading and updating policies, storing and retrieving secrets, rotating credentials, managing public keys, and querying audit information. The canonical OpenAPI specification is published at github.com/cyberark/conjur-openapi-spec; this file is a curated profile of the most-used endpoints aligned with CyberArk Secrets Manager Self-Hosted and SaaS.
